extension.description: Discreet Windows popups when Claude Code or Codex finishes a task in VS Code, including remaining quotas.
configuration.autoConfigure: Automatically installs and repairs Claude/Codex hooks when VS Code starts.
configuration.enabled: Enables or disables all VSignal popups.
configuration.popup.claude.fiveHours: Shows Claude's **5 h** quota bar in popups.
configuration.popup.claude.weekly: Shows Claude's **7 d (weekly)** quota bar in popups.
configuration.popup.codex.fiveHours: Shows Codex's **5 h** quota bar in popups.
configuration.popup.codex.weekly: Shows Codex's **7 d (weekly)** quota bar in popups.
configuration.popup.gemini.weekly: Shows Gemini's **7 d (weekly)** quota bar in test and quota-alert popups.
configuration.popup.claude.taskPercentag: Shows the **Claude** task quota cost as a compact `+N%` indicator on the right side of the popup.
configuration.popup.codex.taskPercentage: Shows the **Codex** task quota cost as a compact `+N%` indicator on the right side of the popup.
configuration.alert.lowQuota.claude: Shows a popup when a **Claude** quota window crosses the warning threshold.
configuration.alert.lowQuota.codex: Shows a popup when a **Codex** quota window crosses the warning threshold.
configuration.alert.lowQuota.gemini: Shows a popup when the **Gemini** weekly quota crosses the warning threshold.
configuration.alert.reset.claude: Shows a popup when a **Claude** quota window resets.
configuration.alert.reset.codex: Shows a popup when a **Codex** quota window resets.
configuration.alert.reset.gemini: Shows a popup when the **Gemini** weekly quota resets.
configuration.alert.threshold: **Used** percentage that triggers a warning. `90` sends the alert when only 10% remains. Applies to both `5 h` and `7 d` windows.
configuration.panel.providers.claude: Shows the **Claude** quota card in the VSignal panel.
configuration.panel.providers.codex: Shows the **Codex** quota card in the VSignal panel.
configuration.panel.providers.gemini: Shows the **Gemini** quota card in the VSignal panel.
configuration.language.auto: Follows the VS Code display language
configuration.language: VSignal language for the panel, popups, and messages. `auto` follows the VS Code display language and falls back to English for unsupported languages. Command and Settings labels always follow the VS Code display language.
